about_the_game:
Vacivus: Resurger is a survival and exploration game set in the devastated world of Terran, fully developed in Unreal Engine 5.

Certain events led civilization to its downfall. Now, you and your companions must face hostile environments and rebuild society from the ashes.

Explore vast regions with dynamic weather, ancient ruins, and forgotten technologies. Face powerful bosses that evolve and adapt as combat progresses, forcing you to rethink your strategies.

Build and customize your base — add crop plots, defend against all who dare to attack you, and shape your own refuge.

Create your own helpers to ease survival and reconstruction — from resource networks to defensive structures — giving you time to focus on what matters most: exploring, progressing, and uncovering the forgotten truth of Terran.

Whether playing solo or with others, Vacivus: Resurger challenges you to reclaim a dying world and shape its future.

🔹 Features:

  • Building and Semi-Automation: Build your base, design production, defense, and logistics systems to reclaim the world and optimize your survival.

  • Adaptive Bosses: Face powerful enemies that learn and evolve based on your tactics, offering a dynamic and personalized challenge.

  • Co-op Gameplay: Experience the journey solo or with your allies, working together to restore life to Terran.

  • Immersive Environment: Dynamic weather and day/night cycles bring the world to life.

  • Developed in Unreal Engine 5: Enjoy next-gen graphics, realistic lighting, and a richly detailed world that pushes the engine to its limits.

content_descriptors.notes: It's a survival game, which has nudity in underwear.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X, Intel Core i7-6800K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT, NVIDIA GeForce 1080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, Intel i5-10600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT, RTX 3060 Ti
